use_cases: Display loading state during async operations like API calls
Show progress indication during page transitions or navigation
Indicate data fetching in progress in content-heavy applications
Provide visual feedback during form submission
Show waiting state while processing user requests
ai_summary: A dual-color animated loading spinner component featuring geometric shapes that follow a perimeter squeeze animation combined with continuous rotation. The loader uses CSS custom properties for customizable colors and animation durations, making it suitable for any application requiring visual feedback during async operations or waiting states.
